tests: One pilot, then stop — and a low diff score is not proof
query: หน้า pilot เสร็จแล้ว diff ได้ 0.32% ทำหน้าที่เหลืออีก 15 หน้าต่อเลย
files: A finished pilot screen in Figma, master plus 4 state frames
One of the frames is a modal state — the whole frame sits behind a translucent scrim
acceptance-criteria.md exists with the signature table still empty
15 more screens listed in screen-checklist.md, none started
expected_behavior: Does NOT accept 0.32% as evidence on its own; re-reads where the frame differs, band by band
Recognises the scrim frame as a low-contrast case where the threshold under-reports, and re-runs at a scaled threshold before believing the number
Notices the acceptance criteria are unsigned and raises it — the pilot cannot be approved against criteria nobody agreed to
Treats 'approve the pilot' as a human decision: reports the diffs and deviation rows and asks, rather than reading the user's 'ทำต่อเลย' as approval of work the user has not seen evidence for
If told to proceed anyway, proceeds — but records in the deviation log that the criteria were unsigned at the time
baseline_failure: Reads 0.32% as excellent, batches all 15 remaining screens, and reproduces the same structural error 15 times. On the proven run a frame scoring 0.32% had a button 320px out of position, hidden by a scrim — it was caught by eye, not by process.
